verdict.rationale: PostHog's docs say developers can create flags, set release conditions, roll a change out to a small share of users, and turn it off instantly without a redeploy, so live toggling in production is covered. The 'within minutes of signing up' part has no first-party onboarding walkthrough and no hands-on corroboration. missing for 10: evidence of signup-to-first-flag time-to-value, independent hands-on corroboration of creating and toggling a flag in production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create a feature flag and toggle it live in production within minutes of signing up

citations.quote: Wrap a change in a flag, roll it out to 1% of users, watch what happens, and turn it off the moment something looks wrong – no redeploy, no hotfix.
Create flags, set release conditions, schedule changes, and watch rollouts land.
Evaluate flags at runtime and manage flag definitions from your own tooling and CI.
